question: Allow 24 destination characters on labels instead of 20 without changing the label layout.
expected_answer: Change format_label's destination slice limit to 24.

visible_sources.text:
# Parcel Path

Parcel Path selects a delivery lane and prints compact shipping labels.

Standard parcels use the ground lane when no service level is supplied.
Weekend pickup adds a fixed surcharge to the quoted delivery price.
Tracking events are retained for 14 days in the local event buffer.

# Routing policy

North-region parcels route through depot N1 before final delivery.
Hazardous parcels cannot use the air lane and must remain on ground transport.
Labels include the tracking code followed by the destination city.

model_response: Labels now allow 24 destination characters instead of 20. The `tracking code | destination` layout is unchanged in [parcel/labels.py](repository/parcel/labels.py:1). Checks passed for 24-character and longer destinations, plus trimming and capitalization.

+++ after/parcel/labels.py
@@ -2 +2 @@
-    destination = city.strip().title()[:20]
+    destination = city.strip().title()[:24]
